svg.title: PD-L1: eligible stained cells and viable tumor denominator
svg.desc: Exact original fictional eligible section: 200 viable invasive tumor cells, 20 with qualifying membrane staining, 40 eligible stained lymphocytes and 20 eligible stained macrophages. The tumor inventory is 20 columns by 10 rows, with one row of 20 positive and nine rows of 180 unstained cells. Immune inventories contain 40 and 20 cells, respectively. Inventories are grouped counting cartoons, not slide coordinates or a substitute for adequacy/controls/cell attribution. CPS is 100 times 80/200 = 40; tumor-cell proportion is 100 times 20/200 = 10 percent, TPS arithmetic only if its rules apply. No clinical cutoff or eligibility inferred.

text.tspan: Immune cells add to the CPS numerator.
Eligibility and staining rules still matter.
TPS arithmetic needs its assay context.
